page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top, page number at top right; a closing dateline and signature block below the text. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: confici potest, destinato tuo in Patriam itineri moram injectam conqueri possis, & ad Serenissimum Regem revertendi optima à semetipso negligeretur occasio.

Interim id tamen tibi, à meo Principe persuasum habeas velim, ipsius Celsitudinem Serenissimo tuo Regi benevolentiam, studium, observantiam atque omnia amicitiae officia & genera deferre polliceri. Vale quam felicissime.

page.notes: Scan is faint and speckled; the Latin line "Interim id tamen tibi" and the dateline numerals are read with some doubt. The page-number "275" and the closing "LXV." are as printed. Several words in the dateline and signature are blurred. Stray specks and show-through omitted.
